judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Vaidyanathan, J.:— When this matter was taken up for hearing today, learned counsel for the Petitioner sought permission of this Court to withdraw this Writ Petition and in this regard, he has sent a letter dated 19.08.2019 to the Registry and has also made an endorsement in the case bundle to the following effect:

“Memo may be recorded and the Writ Petition may be dismissed as withdrawn.”

2. In view of the above, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn. No costs. Consequently, connected M.P. No. 1 of 2014 is closed.
